kinnie starr.bio: Calgary-born multidisciplinary artist Kinnie Starr is a Canadian singer, rapper and songwriter with an independent catalogue shaped by hip-hop, spoken word and alternative music, alongside longstanding activist work.

kreesha turner.bio: Edmonton-born singer-songwriter Kreesha Turner moved from platinum-selling Canadian pop toward a more intimate neo-jazz sound, drawing on R&B, soul and Caribbean influences along the way.

keys n krates.bio: Toronto trio Keys N Krates combines live drums, keyboards and DJing in sample-driven electronic music, bringing the energy of a live band to club-focused production.

luck mervil.bio: Haitian-Canadian singer-songwriter, actor and producer Luck Mervil has built a wide-ranging career in francophone music and theatre, including a major stage role in Notre-Dame de Paris.

maara.bio: Montréal-born producer, DJ and vocalist Maara makes kinetic club music informed by trance, techno and breakbeat after first developing her voice in the city's hip-hop scene.

magi merlin.bio: Montréal singer-songwriter Magi Merlin makes gritty, groove-heavy alternative R&B, pairing sharp writing with soul, hip-hop and experimental-pop influences.

marie davidson.bio: Montréal producer and musician Marie Davidson makes dark, sharply observational electronic music, moving between techno, minimal wave, Italo disco and spoken-word performance.

maylee todd.bio: Toronto multidisciplinary artist Maylee Todd is a singer, songwriter, producer and performance artist known for adventurous work that moves between soul, electronic music and experimental pop.

ouri.bio: French Guianan-born, Montréal-based musician Ouri is a classically trained producer, DJ and multi-instrumentalist who brings orchestral composition into experimental electronic pop and R&B.

neon dreams.bio: Halifax-formed Canadian alt-pop duo Neon Dreams, led by Frank Kadillac and Adrian Morris, makes expansive pop shaped by electronic production and a wide range of rock, folk and rhythmic influences.

olivia lunny.bio: Winnipeg-born Canadian singer-songwriter Olivia Lunny makes melodic alt-pop built around bright synth production, indie-pop textures and dance-ready hooks.

patsy gallant.bio: Campbellton, New Brunswick-born singer and actor Patsy Gallant is a bilingual Acadian-Canadian performer whose decades-long career includes pop, disco and musical theatre.

potatohead people.bio: Vancouver production duo Potatohead People, formed by Nick Wisdom and AstroLogical, makes sample-rich hip-hop rooted in jazz, soul, boogie and funk.

preoccupations.bio: Calgary-formed Canadian band Preoccupations makes dark, kinetic post-punk, using noise, electronics and melodic tension to keep its guitar-driven sound in motion.
